title: Storage Move-In Day Share on Bluegate Moving Truck Rental Additional Days
content:
**Storage tenant terms — additional rental days around a move-in.** On a Bluegate Moving Truck Rental contract, the move-in-day share depends on the renter's storage agreements, read from the renter's Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement records (status, facility and move-in date):

1. when an active storage agreement of the renter at the pickup facility has its move-in date on the actual pickup date or on the actual return date of the contract, the additional days take **0.5** of the rate;
2. when such a move-in — on the actual pickup date or the actual return date — is on an active storage agreement of the renter at another facility, they take **0.75** of the rate;
3. otherwise they take the whole rate.

## Questions answered

**A renter's active storage agreement at the truck's pickup facility moved in on the day the truck was picked up. What share applies?** 0.5 of the rate.

**The move-in on an active agreement at a different Bluegate facility fell on the day the truck came back. What share applies?** 0.75 of the rate.

**The move-in fell on a day between pickup and return, but on neither of those dates. What share applies?** The whole rate.

**The storage agreement whose move-in fell on the pickup date is still in reserved status, not active. What share applies?** The whole rate; only an active agreement counts.

| Active agreement with a move-in on the actual pickup date or actual return date | Share of the rate |
|---|---|
| At the pickup facility | 0.5 |
| Only at another facility | 0.75 |
| None | Whole |
